The Joan and Eugene Vanderpool Fellowship of the American School of Classical Studies at Athens (ASCSA) supports research on the Athenian Agora, the ancient civic centre of Athens. It was set up by the family and friends of Joan and Eugene Vanderpool.

Any topic connected to the Agora is welcome, from antiquity to the present day: history, archaeology, literature, epigraphy, architecture, art history and even biodiversity. Both doctoral students and PhD holders can apply, and the fellowship is open to all nationalities.

Applications for 2027-28 close on 15 March 2027. African classicists, archaeologists and historians working on Athens have the same access as anyone else.
requirements: Graduate student or PhD holder
Research on any aspect of the Athenian Agora, from antiquity to the present
Open to all nationalities
documents: Online application through the ASCSA Submittable form
opportunities.about_provider: The American School of Classical Studies at Athens is a research and teaching institution in Athens, Greece, with a US office in Princeton, New Jersey. It runs excavations, libraries and a wide range of fellowships for scholars of Greece.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply online through the ASCSA Submittable portal (the Vanderpool Fellowship form) before 15 March 2027. Questions about the application go to application@ascsa.org.
opportunities.notes: The official form does not state the award amount or tenure length; check ASCSA's graduate and postdoctoral fellowships page or ask the school before applying.

opportunities.title: Karlstad University Global Scholarship 2027/28
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA students, including Africans, admitted to an eligible autumn 2027 Karlstad Master's can apply for a 50% fee reduction.
opportunities.description:
The Karlstad University Global Scholarship gives a 50% tuition fee reduction to outstanding students from outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland who are admitted to one of Karlstad's eligible Master's programmes starting in autumn 2027. Karlstad University is in Karlstad, Sweden.

For 2027/28, 19 programmes are eligible, including the Master in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Intelligent Communication Systems, Information Systems, English and GeoAI for Sustainable Futures. The award is first granted for one semester and then extended for the whole programme if results are satisfactory.

The scholarship application window runs from 1 to 15 March 2027, after you have applied to the programme through University Admissions in Sweden. Awards are merit-based, so African students with strong academic records and Karlstad as their first choice stand the best chance.
opportunities.benefits: A 50% reduction of the tuition fee, deducted directly from the fee and renewed each semester with satisfactory results. It does not cover living costs; students must still show funds for the Swedish residence permit.
requirements: Citizen of a country outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland
Applied to an eligible Karlstad Master's starting autumn 2027 and paid the application fee
Not living in Sweden more than two years at the start of the scholarship period
No Swedish permanent residence or work permit, and no previous Swedish Master's
Not receiving a Swedish Institute or other Swedish funding scholarship
documents: Optional: up to two signed and stamped reference letters in one PDF
opportunities.selection_process: Selection is merit-based and does not consider financial need. Priority goes to strong academic performance, relevance and motivation, commitment to Karlstad, and having Karlstad as first choice on University Admissions.
opportunities.about_provider: Karlstad University is a Swedish public university in Värmland with around 16,000 students, offering English-taught Master's programmes in fields such as computer science, business and environmental science.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply to an eligible programme at universityadmissions.se during the national application round and pay the fee, then submit the scholarship form linked on the Karlstad page between 1 and 15 March 2027. Late applications are not considered.
opportunities.notes: Karlstad also lists company-funded programme scholarships (EH, Erna Gruppen, Infrakraft, Löfbergs, Uddeholms) and the Swedish Institute scholarships on its site.

opportunities.title: NIAS Individual Fellowship (call opens January 2027)
opportunities.provider: Netherlands Institute for Advanced Study in the Humanities and Social Sciences (NIAS-KNAW)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers in the humanities or social sciences of any nationality with at least three years of academic experience after their PhD can apply for a five- or ten-month residential fellowship in Amsterdam.
opportunities.description:
The NIAS Individual Fellowship lets researchers in the humanities and social sciences spend five or ten months working full-time on their own project at the Netherlands Institute for Advanced Study in Amsterdam. Fellows are expected to be on site for the whole period, joining an international and interdisciplinary group of scholars.

The next call opens on 15 January 2027 and closes on 15 March 2027 at 12:00 noon CET. Outcomes are announced by 15 December 2027 and the resulting cohort is published in August 2028, so this call is for fellowships in the 2028-2029 academic year. NIAS has said the regulations for the 2027 call are not yet published and that requirements may change.

The fellowship is open to applicants from any country; the only stated exclusion concerns affiliation with Russian or Belarusian institutions. NIAS caps each call at 216 applications in three categories of 72, sorted by institutional affiliation, and the third category covers researchers based anywhere outside the Netherlands-linked groups, which includes most applicants from African universities. Because of the cap, applying early in the window matters.
opportunities.benefits: A five- or ten-month full-time residential fellowship at NIAS in Amsterdam to work on your own research project. The financial terms are not stated on the pages read; check the 2027 regulations when they are published.
requirements: At least three years of academic experience after the PhD by the call's closing date
Research project in the humanities and/or social sciences
Able to work in English and be on site full-time in Amsterdam for five or ten months
Only one application per call; a permanent post is not required
Former NIAS fellows may apply only after ten years
Not affiliated with Russian or Belarusian institutions (requirement 12)
documents: Research proposal of up to 1,500 words
CV of up to three pages, listing up to ten core publications, with a narrative of up to 300 words
opportunities.selection_process: Applications are accepted until each of the three affiliation categories reaches 72 (216 in total) or the call closes; they are then reviewed and fellows selected, with outcomes communicated by 15 December 2027.
opportunities.about_provider: NIAS is the Netherlands Institute for Advanced Study in the Humanities and Social Sciences, part of the Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences (KNAW). It hosts cohorts of international fellows in Amsterdam who pursue independent research.
opportunities.how_to_apply: When the call opens on 15 January 2027, complete the online application form on the NIAS website with your proposal, CV and referees. Submit early because each category closes once it reaches 72 applications.
opportunities.notes: The 2027 regulations were not yet published at the time of checking, so confirm the conditions and any stipend or housing terms when the call opens. Questions go to the NIAS selection office.

opportunities.title: OCERPH 2027 Online Conference on Environmental Research and Public Health: Call for Abstracts
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Public health and environmental researchers worldwide, especially students and early-career researchers, can submit abstracts.
opportunities.description:
OCERPH 2027, the 5th International Online Conference on Environmental Research and Public Health, is run by MDPI on its Sciforum platform and promoted by the journal IJERPH with nine other MDPI public-health journals. It takes place entirely online on 12 and 13 July 2027, chaired by Prof. Paul R. Ward of Adelaide University.

The theme is "The Social, Political and Commercial Determinants of Health", and one session is dedicated to responding to new and emerging public health threats in low- and middle-income countries. The chair especially encourages doctoral students and early-career researchers to present.

Abstracts are due by 15 March 2027 and acceptance notices are sent on 12 April 2027. Because it is online, African public-health researchers can present without travel costs.
opportunities.benefits: Online presentation of research to an international audience; the event page also lists awards and publication opportunities in MDPI journals.
requirements: Abstract on environmental research or public health
Open to researchers worldwide, especially doctoral and early-career researchers
documents: Abstract submitted on Sciforum following the instructions for authors
opportunities.selection_process: Abstracts are reviewed by the organisers and authors are notified of acceptance on 12 April 2027.
opportunities.about_provider: MDPI is a Swiss-based open-access publisher, and Sciforum is its platform for online scientific conferences. IJERPH (International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health) is one of its main public-health journals.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Submit your abstract through the Sciforum submission page for OCERPH2027 by 15 March 2027, following the instructions for authors. Questions go to ocerph@mdpi.com.

opportunities.title: TaiwanICDF International Higher Education Scholarship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Outstanding students from TaiwanICDF partner countries can apply from 1 December 2026 to 15 March 2027 for full scholarships to study at partner universities in Taiwan.
opportunities.description:
The TaiwanICDF International Higher Education Scholarship Program gives full scholarships to outstanding students from Taiwan's partner countries to study at Taiwanese universities. It is run by the International Cooperation and Development Fund (TaiwanICDF) with a network of Taiwanese universities known as the Taiwan International Cooperation Alliance, set up in 1998.

Applications for the 2027 intake open on 1 December 2026 and close on 15 March 2027. The list of eligible countries and partner programmes is published in the official guidebook on the TaiwanICDF website. African applicants should check the guidebook to see whether their country qualifies before applying.
opportunities.benefits: A full scholarship for study at a TaiwanICDF partner university in Taiwan. The exact items covered are set out in the official guidebook.
requirements: National of a TaiwanICDF partner country (see the guidebook)
Admission to one of the TaiwanICDF partner programmes
Strong academic record
documents: Documents listed in the TaiwanICDF scholarship guidebook
opportunities.about_provider: The International Cooperation and Development Fund (TaiwanICDF) is Taiwan's development aid agency. It runs projects in agriculture, health, education and technology with partner countries and funds scholarships to train their future leaders.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Download the current guidebook and programme list from the TaiwanICDF scholarship page, choose a partner programme and submit the application between 1 December 2026 and 15 March 2027.
opportunities.notes: Check the guidebook for the current list of eligible countries before applying. Contact: +886-2-2873-2323.

opportunities.title: EMBO | EMBL Symposium: New Approaches and Concepts in Microbiology 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Microbiology researchers of any nationality and career stage can attend; travel grants up to EUR 1,000 are available for those coming from outside Europe.
opportunities.description:
The EMBO | EMBL Symposium "New Approaches and Concepts in Microbiology" is the eighth edition of a biennial meeting at EMBL Heidelberg, Germany, held from 22 to 25 June 2027 both on site and virtually. It covers bacterial physiology, microbiomes, and interactions between bacteria, hosts and phages, through talks, posters and discussion groups.

The organisers offer registration fee waivers, travel grants and childcare grants funded by the EMBL Advanced Training Centre Corporate Partnership Programme and EMBO. Travel grants can reach EUR 1,000 for participants coming from outside Europe, which includes African researchers.

Abstracts are due on 16 March 2027, and financial support is requested together with the abstract. On-site registration closes on 11 May 2027 and virtual registration on 15 June 2027.
opportunities.benefits: Fee waivers covering the registration fee paid, travel grants for flights, trains, local transport, accommodation and visas (up to EUR 400 from within Europe, up to EUR 1,000 from outside Europe), and childcare grants with priority for early-stage researchers. Registration fees: on-site EUR 650 (PhD student), EUR 750 (academia); virtual EUR 190 (PhD), EUR 240 (academia).
requirements: Open to researchers at all career stages, any nationality
Only on-site participants may submit abstracts for presentation
Abstract up to 2,000 characters (excluding spaces), title up to 20 words
For financial help: explain why support is needed
documents: Financial assistance request in the submission form
Travel receipts within two months of travel (for reimbursement)
opportunities.selection_process: Abstracts are selected about three weeks after the deadline. Financial assistance is decided separately based on scientific merit, where the applicant works or studies, the reasons for needing support and the expected career impact.
important_dates: Abstract and financial assistance deadline: 16 March 2027
opportunities.about_provider: EMBL (the European Molecular Biology Laboratory) runs an international course and conference programme at its Advanced Training Centre in Heidelberg. EMBO is the European organisation that supports life scientists and co-funds the symposium series.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Register on the EMBL event page and submit an abstract by 16 March 2027, ticking the request for a fee waiver, travel or childcare grant. Even with a waiver, a place is confirmed only once the registration fee is paid, and the waiver then refunds it.
opportunities.notes: Organisers may lower the travel grant caps. Grants are paid as reimbursement, so keep all receipts.

opportunities.title: UNB Masters Recruitment Funding Program 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: New domestic or international students entering a thesis-based Master's at UNB can be considered for several recruitment awards.
opportunities.description:
The University of New Brunswick (UNB) in Canada runs a Masters Recruitment Funding Program to attract new students into thesis-based (research) Master's degrees on its Fredericton and Saint John campuses. It is open to incoming domestic and international students, so African applicants can be considered.

A single application is assessed for several awards at once: the Masters Open Award, the Masters International Differential Tuition Scholarship (which offsets the extra fees paid by international students) and the ResearchNB Masters Merit Award.

The School of Graduate Studies has two rounds for 2027: 26 January 2027 and 16 March 2027. Applicants also need to apply separately for admission, and international students are advised to apply at least six months before they plan to start.
opportunities.benefits: Consideration for the Masters Open Award, the Masters International Differential Tuition Scholarship and the ResearchNB Masters Merit Award (amounts not stated on the official page).
requirements: Incoming student to a research (thesis-based) Master's at UNB
Domestic or international applicants
Official English test scores if English is not your first language
Some programmes require a confirmed supervisor
documents: Letter of recommendation from a past supervisor or instructor, the prospective supervisor, or a department letter of support
For admission: transcripts and three reference letters
opportunities.about_provider: The University of New Brunswick, founded in 1785, is one of Canada's oldest public universities, with campuses in Fredericton and Saint John. Its School of Graduate Studies manages graduate admissions and funding.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Submit the new-student awards application through UNB's online recruitment portal, then send the supporting documents. Apply separately for your programme at apply.unb.ca (fee CAD 125 for international applicants), ideally at least six months in advance.
opportunities.notes: Applying by Round 1 gives two chances. International UNB undergraduate alumni receive a separate automatic tuition subsidy that cannot be combined with the differential tuition scholarship.

opportunities.title: ECSO-CMS 2027 Travel and Attendance Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: PhD students, early-career researchers and carers with an accepted ECSO-CMS 2027 abstract can apply, with no nationality limit stated.
opportunities.description:
ECSO-CMS 2027 is the joint European Conference on Stochastic Optimization and Computational Management Science, hosted by the Department of Management Science at Lancaster University, UK, from 20 to 23 June 2027. The organisers offer a limited number of travel and attendance grants sponsored by STOR-i, Lancaster's centre for statistics and operational research.

Grants are open to PhD students, early-career researchers (usually within eight years of their PhD) and delegates of any career stage with caring responsibilities. No nationality restriction is stated, so African researchers in optimisation and operations research can apply, provided they have an accepted abstract as corresponding author.

Grant applications are due by 18 March 2027 and decisions are announced on 1 April 2027. Abstracts for the conference must be submitted by 4 February 2027.
opportunities.benefits: PhD students: registration fee, economy travel and accommodation. Early-career researchers: economy travel and accommodation (not registration). Delegates with caring responsibilities: travel including extra caregiving logistics and accommodation. Each grant is capped at an amount confirmed in the award letter and reimbursed after the event against receipts.
requirements: Accepted abstract for ECSO-CMS 2027 as corresponding author
PhD student, early-career researcher (typically within 8 years of PhD), or delegate with caring responsibilities
Willing to pay upfront and claim reimbursement with itemised receipts
documents: Motivation letter with name, email, country, organisation and applicant category
opportunities.about_provider: Lancaster University's Department of Management Science is one of the UK's leading operational research departments. STOR-i is its doctoral training centre in statistics and operational research.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Once your abstract is accepted, email the motivation letter, budget and justification to ecsocms@lancaster.ac.uk by 18 March 2027. The organisers advise waiting for the grant decision before registering.

opportunities.title: Academy of Korean Studies Graduate School 2027 Fall Special Admission (International)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: International students admitted to the Graduate School of Korean Studies receive a full tuition waiver, and 15 newcomers also receive a KRW 800,000 monthly stipend for one year.

opportunities.title: TARK 2027: Theoretical Aspects of Rationality and Knowledge
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers worldwide can submit papers by the deadline for this conference (Prague, 2027).

opportunities.title: Chinese Government Scholarship (Type B) at Nankai University
opportunities.eligibility_summary: International applicants to full-time master's or PhD study at Nankai apply through both the Nankai and CSC systems for a fully funded award.

opportunities.title: Applied Bioinformatics and Public Health Microbiology Conference 2027 (bursary)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers worldwide can attend; bursaries prioritise students and LMIC applicants, and LMIC delegates attend online for free.
opportunities.description:
Applied Bioinformatics and Public Health Microbiology is an established conference, now in its 11th edition, run by Wellcome Connecting Science at the Wellcome Genome Campus in Hinxton, UK, from 16 to 18 June 2027, with a virtual option. It covers genomic surveillance, pathogen genomics, bioinformatics and AI for global health.

Bursaries usually cover up to half of the registration fee and give priority to PhD students and trainees, applicants from low- and middle-income countries and people from under-represented groups. Delegates from LMICs, which include most African countries, can join virtually free of charge.

The bursary deadline is 22 March 2027 (also the end of early-bird in-person registration), and abstracts close on 19 April 2027. The page noted that registration was temporarily suspended for technical reasons when checked.
opportunities.benefits: Bursaries usually up to 50% of the registration fee. Virtual attendance is free for LMIC delegates. In-person fees: student GBP 269 early-bird (GBP 359 standard), academic GBP 369 (GBP 459); on-site accommodation GBP 240.
requirements: Registered delegate applying for a bursary with an abstract
Priority: PhD students/trainees, LMIC applicants and under-represented groups
Oral presenters must attend on site
documents: Online bursary application explaining need and expected benefit
Abstract following the Wellcome Connecting Science guidelines
opportunities.selection_process: Bursaries are allocated to priority groups first and to other early-career researchers if funds allow; applications without an abstract are only considered in exceptional cases. Results come about two weeks after the abstract deadline.
opportunities.about_provider: Wellcome Connecting Science, part of the Wellcome Sanger Institute and funded by Wellcome, runs courses and conferences on genomics and biomedical science at the Wellcome Genome Campus near Cambridge, UK.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Register for the conference and choose 'apply for a bursary', complete the online form, then submit your abstract through the link emailed to you before the bursary deadline of 22 March 2027 (23:59 UK time).
opportunities.notes: Registration was suspended for technical issues when checked; try again later. Contact: events@sanger.ac.uk.

opportunities.title: CCET 2027: 10th International Conference on Computer and Communication Engineering Technology
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers of any nationality with original work in computer and communication engineering can submit.
opportunities.description:
CCET 2027, the 10th International Conference on Computer and Communication Engineering Technology, will be held at North China University of Technology in Beijing from 13 to 15 August 2027. It is hosted by the university's School of Artificial Intelligence and Computer Science and co-sponsored with Taiyuan University of Technology.

The conference invites papers on topics such as algorithms, computer architecture, network security, RF and microwave engineering and remote sensing. Accepted, peer-reviewed papers are published in an international conference proceedings, and authors who only want to present can send an abstract instead.

The submission deadline is 25 March 2027. The call is open to researchers worldwide, including African engineers and computer scientists, but there are no grants and at least one author of each paper must pay the registration fee.
opportunities.benefits: No funding. Accepted papers are published in the conference proceedings and presented in Beijing; early submission and registration receive lower fees.
requirements: Original paper in computer or communication engineering
At least one author registers and pays the fee
Plagiarism checks apply; plagiarised papers are rejected automatically
documents: Full paper via EasyChair, or an abstract by email for presentation only
opportunities.selection_process: Full papers are peer reviewed before acceptance into the proceedings.
opportunities.about_provider: North China University of Technology is a public university in Beijing; its School of Artificial Intelligence and Computer Science hosts CCET 2027 with Taiyuan University of Technology as co-sponsor.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Submit a full paper through EasyChair (https://easychair.org/conferences/?conf=ccet2027), or email an abstract to ccet@bmail.org if you only want to present. Fees are on the conference website's registration page.

opportunities.title: Luiss Scholarships for Non-EU and Non-Schengen Students (Bachelor's and Single-Cycle Master's, 2027/2028)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Non-EU, non-Schengen citizens admitted to the first year of a Luiss bachelor's or single-cycle master's through the extra-EU admission route for 2027/2028.
opportunities.description:
Luiss Guido Carli University in Rome has published a call offering 50 scholarships to students from outside the European Union and the Schengen area who enter the first year of one of its bachelor's degrees or single-cycle master's degrees in the 2027/2028 academic year. The awards are reserved for students admitted through the university's extra-EU / extra-Schengen admission procedure.

The scholarships reduce tuition rather than pay a living allowance: some cancel the annual fee entirely, others halve it or cut the first instalment. Winners are ranked according to the route by which they were admitted, such as the Luiss test, LSAT, SAT/ACT or International Baccalaureate.

For African school leavers aiming at a private Italian university with programmes in economics, management, law and political science, this call can significantly lower the cost of a degree in Rome. The application window runs from 9 February to 25 March 2027, so applicants should complete their admission application first.
opportunities.benefits: 50 tuition-fee waivers in total: 20 full waivers of the annual single fee; 19 waivers of 50% of the first and second instalments; 11 partial waivers of the first instalment. Regional taxes remain payable and no other benefits (such as a stipend) are given. Awards can be renewed in later years if academic conditions are met.
requirements: Citizenship of a country outside the EU and the Schengen area
Admission (or pending admission result) through the Luiss extra-EU / extra-Schengen procedure to year 1 of a bachelor's or single-cycle master's for 2027/2028
Students admitted through any other Luiss procedure are not eligible
For renewal: at least 70% of the required credits by the end of the summer session and a weighted average of at least 26/30
documents: Online application via the Luiss portal
An Italian tax code (codice fiscale) is needed to register
opportunities.selection_process: Separate ranking lists are drawn up for each admission route (Luiss test including the summer school test, LSAT, SAT/ACT, or IB). Ties go to the younger candidate. Results are posted in the applicant's personal area and sent by email by May 2027.
opportunities.about_provider: Luiss Guido Carli is a private university in Rome specialising in economics and business, law, and political science, with many programmes taught in English. It runs a separate admission route for applicants from outside the EU and Schengen area.
opportunities.how_to_apply: First apply for admission to Luiss through the extra-EU / extra-Schengen procedure. Then, between 9 February and 25 March 2027, complete the scholarship form online through the Luiss website, registering with a codice fiscale. Applicants still waiting for their admission result may apply.
opportunities.notes: The awards only reduce tuition; plan separately for living costs in Rome. Questions: agevolazionieconomiche@luiss.it.

opportunities.title: Paris Conference on Education 2027 (PCE2027): Call for Papers and Scholarships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers worldwide can submit an abstract by 26 March 2027, and postgraduate students and early-career academics who submit by 15 January 2027 can be considered for full or partial scholarships.
opportunities.description:
IAFOR's sixth Paris Conference on Education (PCE2027) runs from 5 to 9 July 2027 in Paris and online. The organisers invite abstracts on education research for oral talks of 25 minutes, posters, panels, workshops, live-streamed presentations over Zoom and pre-recorded virtual presentations.

Abstracts are judged by double-blind peer review followed by a final check by the programme committee. Authors who are accepted can later send a full paper for the conference proceedings, which are published but not peer reviewed.

What makes this call useful for African students and young academics is its scholarship scheme: the Stuart D. B. Picken Scholarship pays travel, accommodation and registration, and the IAFOR Scholarship pays the registration fee. To be considered, applicants must submit their abstract by the early-bird date of 15 January 2027. The online presentation options also let people take part without travelling.
opportunities.benefits: Stuart D. B. Picken Scholarship: travel, accommodation and conference registration fees are covered. IAFOR Scholarship: conference registration fee covered. Accepted authors can publish a full paper in the conference proceedings.
requirements: Abstract of no more than 250 words
Author name, affiliation, country and paper title
Scholarships: enrolled PhD or master's student, or early-career academic who finished a postgraduate programme within the last five years
Scholarships: abstract submitted by 15 January 2027
Scholarships stage 2: a 60-second video
documents: Full paper in Microsoft Word format for the proceedings (optional, after acceptance)
opportunities.selection_process: Each abstract goes through double-blind peer review and then a final review by the programme committee; results usually come within four weeks. Authors may be asked to review up to five other abstracts. Scholarship applicants who pass the first stage are asked for a short video.
important_dates: Early-bird abstract deadline (and scholarship deadline): 15 January 2027
Conference: 5 to 9 July 2027, Paris and online
opportunities.about_provider: The International Academic Forum (IAFOR) is an international organisation that runs interdisciplinary academic conferences around the world, working with global and events partners.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Create an account on the IAFOR submission portal and submit your abstract for PCE2027. To apply for a scholarship, tick the scholarship box during abstract submission before 15 January 2027 and follow the scholarship application page.
opportunities.notes: Registration fees were not shown on the pages read. Proceedings are not peer reviewed, so check your institution's requirements if you need a peer-reviewed output.

opportunities.title: Hartpury University Vice-Chancellor's International Undergraduate Scholarship 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: International fee payers of any nationality with a full-time September 2027 undergraduate offer at Hartpury's Gloucestershire campus can apply by 30 March 2027 for £3,000 off first-year fees.
opportunities.description:
Hartpury University in Gloucestershire, England, offers a £3,000 Vice-Chancellor's International Undergraduate Scholarship to international students starting a full-time degree at its Gloucestershire campus in September 2027. The award is a discount on first-year tuition.

It looks for applicants who show academic potential, drive and a commitment to making a positive difference. A selection panel decides who receives it.

Hartpury specialises in agriculture, animal, equine, veterinary nursing and sport subjects, which makes the scholarship attractive to African students interested in agriculture and land-based careers. Any applicant who pays international fees can apply.
opportunities.benefits: A £3,000 discount on tuition fees in the first year only. There is no cash alternative, and it cannot be used for the deposit.
requirements: Full-time undergraduate offer at Hartpury's Gloucestershire campus starting September 2027
International fee status
Meet all offer and admissions conditions
Not fully funded by an external sponsor
Only one Hartpury scholarship can be held
documents: Online scholarship application form linked from the official page
opportunities.selection_process: The university's scholarship panel chooses recipients at its own discretion, looking at academic potential, drive and commitment to positive impact. Its decision is final.
opportunities.about_provider: Hartpury University is a specialist university near Gloucester, England, set on a large rural estate with working farms, equine and sports facilities. It focuses on agriculture, animals, equine studies, veterinary nursing and sport.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply for and receive a full-time undergraduate offer from Hartpury for September 2027. Then complete the separate scholarship form through the 'Apply now' link on the official page by 30 March 2027, and accept the award within 14 days if offered.
opportunities.notes: Deferring or withdrawing cancels the award. Online, partner and overseas-delivered courses are excluded.

opportunities.title: University of Lille Graduate Programme Fellowships 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students of any nationality applying to a University of Lille Graduate Programme master's track can apply from 15 February to 30 March 2027 for €8,500 (first-time international) or €4,500.
opportunities.description:
The University of Lille in northern France offers master's fellowships through its 21 Graduate Programmes, which are research-oriented master's tracks. The aim is to attract very talented students, including from abroad, into these tracks.

International students coming to French higher education for the first time receive €8,500 for the year, paid in ten monthly instalments from October. French students, international students already in France and students renewing their award receive €4,500. Renewal for the second master's year needs a new application.

The call runs from 15 February to 30 March 2027, with results on 30 April 2027. No nationality is excluded, so African students applying to a Lille graduate programme can apply.
opportunities.benefits: €8,500 for one academic year for first-time incoming international students, or €4,500 for others, paid in ten monthly instalments from October after registration and proof of physical presence. The number of awards is not stated.
requirements: Applying to a master's track within one of Lille's Graduate Programmes
Strong academic record (track, grades and home institution are assessed)
A research project that fits the programme
No nationality restriction
documents: CV (with grades or class rank if possible)
Certified copy of degree or certificate of registration
Transcripts for the last two years
opportunities.selection_process: Applications are judged on academic criteria (study track, academic record, home institution) and professional criteria (research project and its fit with the graduate programme). Incomplete files are not considered.
opportunities.about_provider: The University of Lille is one of France's largest public universities, based in the Lille metropolitan area. Its Graduate Programmes are funded under the national France 2030 investment plan with support from the ANR and the Lille metropolitan authority (MEL).
opportunities.how_to_apply: Submit the online application on the MoveOn platform (in English or French) between 15 February and 30 March 2027, uploading all required documents. Only your most recent application counts. Questions go to grants-graduate-programmes@univ-lille.fr.
opportunities.notes: Second-year renewal requires a separate MoveOn application. Lille also runs an International Mobility Grant for its graduate programmes.

opportunities.title: Amiri Scholarship (Fall 2027 intake)
opportunities.provider: University of Doha for Science and Technology (UDST)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Top international school leavers (90% average, IELTS 7.0) admitted to a UDST bachelor's can apply from 10 January to 31 March 2027.
opportunities.description:
The Amiri Scholarship is the most prestigious award given by the University of Doha for Science and Technology (UDST) in Qatar. It funds a full bachelor's degree in applied fields such as engineering, computing, health sciences and business for both Qatar residents and international students.

For international students the scholarship pays tuition, books, health insurance, accommodation and transport, visa fees, a yearly return economy flight and a monthly stipend, for up to four years. Applications for the Fall 2027 intake are accepted from 10 January to 31 March 2027 through the UDST applicant portal.

The award targets top school leavers: an average of at least 90%, strong English and maths test scores and evidence of extracurricular activities. African students graduating from secondary school in 2026 or 2027 can apply, as long as they are also admitted to UDST.
opportunities.benefits: For international students: full tuition fee waiver for a bachelor's degree, monthly stipend (amount not stated), textbook fee waiver, health insurance, accommodation and transportation, visa processing fees and one round-trip economy ticket per year, for up to four years.
requirements: Admission to UDST and to the chosen programme
Graduate of a government, private or international school in or outside Qatar, in the same or previous academic year
High school average of at least 90% or equivalent, with the subjects required by the college (for example maths plus chemistry or physics for engineering and computing)
English: IELTS 7.0 (no band below 6.5), TOEFL iBT 95 (no section below 22) or SAT EBRW 550
Maths: SAT Math 550 or ACT Math 22
To keep it: CGPA of 3.00, 12 credits per Fall/Winter semester and 30 credits per year
documents: Attested transcript from the home country (international applicants)
Official English and maths test results
opportunities.selection_process: Selection is competitive and considers academic performance, test results, extracurricular activities, programme requirements and the number of scholarships available.
opportunities.about_provider: The University of Doha for Science and Technology is a public applied university in Doha, Qatar, offering bachelor's and master's degrees in applied and technical fields. The Amiri Scholarship is its flagship award.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Submit a UDST admission application first. Then, between 10 January and 31 March 2027, complete the Amiri Scholarship form in the UDST applicant portal with your test results, references and transcripts. UDST says it will publish step-by-step instructions before the window opens.
opportunities.notes: The stipend amount is not stated. Contact amirischolarship@udst.edu.qa with questions. The 2027 window is not open until 10 January 2027.

opportunities.title: Bartlett Promise Sub-Saharan Africa Master's Scholarship 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Fully funded Bartlett master's for nationals and residents of eligible Sub-Saharan African countries (Cameroon and Sudan currently excluded) holding a UCL Bartlett offer for September 2027 with household income under £42,875.

opportunities.title: Bishop's University Automatic Entrance Scholarships 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: First-year applicants, including international students with recognised school qualifications, are considered automatically if they apply by 31 March 2027.
opportunities.description:
Bishop's University, a small liberal arts university in Sherbrooke, Quebec, automatically considers first-year applicants for entrance scholarships based on the grades used for their admission decision. No separate scholarship application is needed.

Students entering from high school can receive between CAD 1,000 and 4,000, and the page notes that A-levels, IB, French Baccalaureate and other recognised qualifications may be eligible, so African school leavers can be considered. For Fall 2027, applications must be in by 31 March 2027 to be considered for entrance scholarships.

Bishop's also has competitive entrance scholarships with a separate form, such as the Michael Goldbloom Excellence Scholarship worth CAD 17,000 a year for high school entrants, also due 31 March. Around 55% of its students receive some financial help.
opportunities.benefits: Automatic entrance scholarships of CAD 1,000 to 4,000 for high school entrants, paid in two equal instalments (Fall and Winter). Competitive awards such as the Michael Goldbloom Excellence Scholarship (CAD 17,000 per year for high school entrants, renewable) require a separate application.
requirements: First-time university entrant for Fall 2027
Admission average from high school, A-levels, IB, French Baccalaureate or another recognised qualification
Register in at least 12 credits for Fall 2027 to receive the first instalment
For the Winter instalment: 12 credits in Fall, a Fall average of at least 70% and 12 credits for Winter 2028
documents: Bishop's admission application with academic results
Separate form only for competitive scholarships and bursaries
opportunities.selection_process: Automatic scholarships are assigned from the admission average calculated by the university; competitive scholarships are judged on a separate application.
important_dates: Entrance scholarship deadline for Fall 2027: 31 March 2027
opportunities.about_provider: Bishop's University is a primarily undergraduate, English-language liberal arts university in Sherbrooke, Quebec, Canada. It awards more than CAD 7 million in scholarships and bursaries each year.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply for admission through Bishop's online application before 31 March 2027 to be considered automatically. For competitive scholarships such as the Goldbloom award, also submit the separate competitive scholarship form by 31 March.
opportunities.notes: Check Bishop's international high school admission requirements page for how African qualifications such as WASSCE are assessed.

opportunities.title: Chulabhorn Graduate Institute Postgraduate Scholarship 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Fully funded master's and PhD study in Bangkok for science, medical or pharmacy graduates under 30 with lab research experience and English proficiency; round 1 closes 11 December 2026 and round 2 on 31 March 2027.

opportunities.title: IEEE Conference on Artificial Intelligence (CAI) 2027 Call for Papers
opportunities.eligibility_summary: AI researchers and practitioners of any nationality can submit papers.
opportunities.description:
The 2027 IEEE Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IEEE CAI 2027) is an international conference and exhibition focused on applications of AI and key AI industry areas. It will take place at Marina Bay Sands in Singapore from 30 November to 2 December 2027.

The conference is sponsored by the IEEE Computer Society, the IEEE Signal Processing Society, the IEEE Computational Intelligence Society and the IEEE Systems, Man, and Cybernetics Society. According to the IEEE SPS events calendar, the paper submission deadline is 31 March 2027.

The call is open to authors from any country, giving African AI researchers and engineers a route into a major applied-AI venue in Asia. The conference site also offers visa assistance letters, while SPS members can look at the society's separate travel grants.
opportunities.benefits: No funding is described on the conference pages. Accepted papers are presented in Singapore; IEEE SPS members may apply separately for SPS travel grants.
requirements: Original paper on applications of artificial intelligence
Open to authors of any nationality
opportunities.about_provider: IEEE is the world's largest technical professional organisation. CAI is co-sponsored by four IEEE societies covering computing, signal processing, computational intelligence and systems engineering.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Watch the IEEE CAI 2027 website (cai.ieee.org/2027) for the call for papers and submission portal, which were not yet published when checked, and submit before 31 March 2027. Visa assistance letters can be requested through the conference registration site.
opportunities.notes: The deadline currently comes from the IEEE SPS calendar; confirm it once the conference posts its full call.

opportunities.title: IEEE ICIP 2027 Call for Papers (Singapore, Nov 2027)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers of any nationality can submit image processing papers to ICIP 2027.
opportunities.description:
ICIP 2027, the IEEE International Conference on Image Processing, is the flagship conference of the IEEE Signal Processing Society for image and video processing, computer vision and machine learning. It will be held at the Sands Expo and Convention Centre in Singapore from 29 November to 3 December 2027.

Authors can submit regular or special-session papers for the IEEE Xplore proceedings, papers for the IEEE Open Journal of Signal Processing, one-page work-in-progress abstracts, or requests to present published SPS journal papers. Regular papers and OJ-SP papers are due on 31 March 2027 (23:59 AoE), with double-anonymous review.

The conference is open to authors worldwide, so African image-processing and vision researchers can submit. Visa assistance letters are available through the conference site.
opportunities.benefits: No funding is stated on the conference pages. Accepted papers are published in IEEE Xplore or OJ-SP and presented in Singapore.
requirements: Original work in image or video processing, vision or related machine learning
Regular papers: up to 5 pages of content plus 1 optional page of references (check the 6-page rule)
Double-anonymous submission
Open to authors of any nationality
documents: Anonymised paper in the ICIP template
opportunities.selection_process: Papers go through double-anonymous peer review, with reviews released on 25 June 2027, author rebuttal by 7 July and decisions on 6 August 2027.
important_dates: Special session and tutorial proposals: 24 February 2027
Regular and OJ-SP paper deadline: 31 March 2027
opportunities.about_provider: The IEEE Signal Processing Society is the world's main professional society for signal processing, and ICIP is its flagship annual conference on image processing.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Prepare an anonymised paper using the ICIP 2027 template and submit it through the portal linked from the conference call for papers by 31 March 2027. Questions go through the contact page on 2027.ieeeicip.org.
opportunities.notes: The call text and the dates table describe the page limit slightly differently; confirm before submitting.

opportunities.title: ISD 2027 Information Systems Development Conference Call for Papers
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers worldwide can submit information systems development papers to ISD 2027 in Karlstad by 31 March 2027.
opportunities.description:
ISD 2027 is the 35th International Conference on Information Systems Development, an annual meeting held since 1997 for researchers, practitioners and educators who study how information systems are designed, built and used. The 2027 edition is hosted by Karlstad Business School at Karlstad University, Sweden, from 23 to 25 August 2027, returning to Karlstad 22 years after ISD 2005.

The call invites research papers, posters and journal-first presentations across eight tracks, including one on AI and data science for information systems development. The paper deadline is 31 March 2027, with notification planned for 9 June 2027.

For African researchers and doctoral students in information systems, software engineering and digital innovation, ISD is a well-established European venue. No travel support is offered, and presenting authors pay a registration fee.
opportunities.benefits: No funding is offered to authors. Registration for presenting authors is EUR 600 (EUR 500 for AIS members, EUR 400 for students) and includes transport, lunches and the gala dinner.
requirements: Original research on information systems development (no previously published work)
Submission by 31 March 2027 through EasyChair
Submissions are checked for plagiarism and AI-generated writing
No nationality restriction is stated
documents: Research paper, poster or journal-first submission through EasyChair
opportunities.selection_process: Submissions are peer reviewed by the track programme committees. Notification is planned for 9 June 2027, with conditional-accept revisions due 18 June 2027.
opportunities.about_provider: ISD is a long-running international conference series on information systems development, held every year since 1997. The 2027 edition is organised by Karlstad Business School at Karlstad University in Sweden.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Choose a track, prepare an original paper and submit it through the ISD 2027 EasyChair page (easychair.org/conferences/?conf=isd2027) by 31 March 2027. Check the conference website for formatting and submission details.
opportunities.notes: Student registration is EUR 400. The submission system start date is still to be announced.

opportunities.title: Langara International Regional Entrance Scholarship (Fall 2027)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: New full-time international undergraduates from Africa and other listed regions with an 80% average can apply by 31 March 2027 for Fall 2027.
opportunities.description:
The International Regional Entrance Scholarship is an entrance award from Langara College in Vancouver, Canada, for new international students who start full-time undergraduate studies. It is worth CAD 7,500 in total and is offered to students from specific world regions, with Africa named among them.

For the Fall 2027 term, the application closes at 4:00 pm on Wednesday 31 March 2027 (the Summer 2027 deadline is 15 January 2027). The money goes straight to tuition: CAD 5,000 is applied in the first term and the rest is credited in the second term if the student stays full-time and keeps a cumulative GPA of at least 2.67.

The award is aimed at strong students with an average of 80% or more. It suits African school leavers and graduates who want to start a regular diploma or degree programme at a public college in Vancouver and need help with the first year's fees.
opportunities.benefits: CAD 7,500 in total: CAD 5,000 applied to tuition and fees in the first term, and the balance credited to tuition in the second term, subject to full-time study and a CGPA of 2.67. Awards over CAD 500 are reported on a T4A tax slip.
requirements: Newly admitted or conditionally admitted full fee-paying international student for the term
Full-time study (9 or more credits) in a regular undergraduate programme or an eligible full-time Continuing Studies programme; post-degree diplomas and certificates do not qualify
Minimum average of 80% from secondary school or post-secondary studies (post-secondary only with a completed credential from outside Canada)
From an eligible region: Americas, Africa, South Asia, Southeast Asia, East Asia, Middle East, Europe or CIS
Bachelor's grades are considered first; master's grades only if the bachelor's GPA is below 80%
documents: Transcripts showing at least 80% (official English translation if needed)
Personal statement on your reasons for applying and your academic merit
opportunities.selection_process: Applicants who meet the grade and regional criteria are assessed on their transcripts and personal statement. The page does not state the number of awards or a ranking method.
opportunities.about_provider: Langara College is a public college in Vancouver, British Columbia, at 100 West 49th Avenue. It offers university transfer, diploma and degree programmes and enrols a large number of international students.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply for admission to Langara first and obtain an offer (or conditional offer). Then complete the Fall 2027 application form on the scholarship page, uploading your offer letter, transcripts and personal statement (up to two files each), before 4:00 pm on 31 March 2027.
opportunities.notes: Questions can be sent to geninfo@langara.ca. Keep full-time status and a 2.67 CGPA in the first term to receive the second-term part of the award.

opportunities.title: MECO 2027: Mediterranean Conference on Embedded Computing
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers worldwide can submit embedded computing papers to MECO 2027 in Budva by 31 March 2027.
opportunities.description:
MECO 2027 is the 16th Mediterranean Conference on Embedded Computing, a series that has run since 2012. It will take place at Akademija Znanja in Budva, Montenegro, from 8 to 11 June 2027.

The call welcomes full papers, demo papers, project dissemination papers, product presentations, tutorials and keynote proposals on embedded computing and related electronics and computer engineering topics. Proceedings are published by IEEE, and outstanding papers are invited to journals indexed in SCIE. Abstracts must be registered by 30 March 2027 and papers submitted by 31 March 2027.

The conference is a good venue for African engineers and graduate students working on embedded systems, IoT, electronics and computing. The call does not mention travel grants or fee waivers.
opportunities.benefits: No funding is offered to authors. Accepted papers appear in IEEE-published proceedings, and outstanding papers are invited to SCIE-indexed journals.
requirements: Original work not submitted elsewhere at the same time
Abstract registered by 30 March 2027
Paper submitted by 31 March 2027
No nationality restriction is stated
documents: Abstract registration and full paper (or demo, project, product or tutorial submission) through EasyChair
opportunities.selection_process: Submissions are reviewed by the conference programme committee.
opportunities.about_provider: MECO is an annual Mediterranean conference on embedded computing, held since 2012, with proceedings published by IEEE.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Register an abstract and then upload your paper through the MECO 2027 EasyChair page (easychair.org/conferences/?conf=meco2027) by 31 March 2027. Contact meco.conference@gmail.com or info@mecoconference.me with questions.
opportunities.notes: Check mecoconference.me for page limits and registration fees, which the call does not state.

opportunities.title: SJTU Scholarship for International Graduate Students
opportunities.eligibility_summary: International master's (35 or under) and PhD (40 or under) applicants to SJTU for September 2027 can apply by 31 March 2027.
opportunities.description:
Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) offers its own scholarships to international students starting master's or doctoral degrees in September 2027. The awards are part of the 2027 International Graduate Admissions Guide, and applications have been open since 5 November 2026.

There are several levels. Doctoral and master's SJTU Scholarships include a monthly stipend, a tuition waiver, Chinese group insurance and a partial housing subsidy, while Tuition Waiver Scholarships cover tuition and insurance. Exact amounts are shown in the online application system. Master's programmes usually last two to three years and doctorates about four.

The deadline for SJTU and Shanghai Government Scholarship applications is 31 March 2027. Applicants who are not nominated for the Chinese Government Scholarship are considered automatically for these awards, which makes SJTU a strong option for African graduates seeking a funded degree in China.
opportunities.benefits: Depending on the level awarded: monthly stipend, tuition waiver, China group insurance and partial accommodation subsidy (doctoral and master's SJTU Scholarships), or tuition and insurance only (Tuition Waiver Scholarship). Amounts are listed in the application system; funding periods are not normally extended.
requirements: Non-Chinese citizen with a valid ordinary passport
Master's: degree equivalent to a Chinese bachelor's; doctoral: degree equivalent to a Chinese master's (final-year students may apply)
Age limit for scholarship: master's 35 or under, doctoral 40 or under
Not holding other scholarship funding; good health and medical examination
Language proof as set in SJTU's language requirements
documents: Degree certificate with CSCSE verification for foreign degrees
Transcripts (with GPA statement if not shown)
Passport valid at least 12 months after enrolment
Two recommendation letters from associate professors or above (or senior professionals)
Doctoral applicants: summary of research experience; some schools ask for a supervisor's letter of intent
opportunities.selection_process: After the deadline the university reviews the documents and decides the level of award. Results are posted in the application system; there is no separate written notice.
opportunities.about_provider: Shanghai Jiao Tong University is one of China's leading research universities, based in Shanghai. Its Graduate School and International Affairs Office manage admissions and scholarships for international graduate students.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply online at apply.sjtu.edu.cn for an SJTU master's or doctoral programme starting September 2027 and choose 'Apply for scholarships through the University'. Upload all documents as scans and pay the RMB 800 fee before 31 March 2027.
opportunities.notes: The Chinese Government Scholarship through SJTU has earlier university deadlines (15 December 2026 first round, 15 February 2027 final). Contact gs.admission@sjtu.edu.cn.

opportunities.title: Seoul National University President Fellowship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Fully funded PhD fellowship for students from developing countries.

opportunities.title: Shanghai Government Scholarship at Shanghai Jiao Tong University
opportunities.eligibility_summary: International graduate applicants to SJTU for September 2027 are considered automatically if they apply through the university by 31 March 2027.

The Shanghai Government Scholarship is funded by the Shanghai municipal government and awarded through universities in the city, including Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU). At SJTU it is open to international students applying for master's or doctoral programmes that start in September 2027.
